ownership: Read owns File, offset/bytes, SlotLease, active Ticket; worker owns allocated/zeroed Vec through read_exact_at.
Completed moves Result<Vec<u8>> across channel; ready/poll move ownership to main.
Main upload allocates shared Metal backing and copies Vec; from_backing retains cloned Buffer in projection views and cache.
DemandPlan generation publication occurs only after successful from_backing. Prefetch has same upload path.
Timeout retains owned I/O destination until completion; active ticket drops before send. No unretained GPU pointer currently crosses workers.
minimal_trial: Experimental direct read into main-created exact-size shared backing with exclusive owned job destination, return backing through Completed; preserve lease validation/cache policy/three waves/kernels. Verify Buffer transfer legality first; no naked pointer and retain timed-out reads through completion.
historical_exclusions: ColdShared changes shared/W1 placement, T01B MLX prepared encoder; neither removes current native Vec→shared buffer copy. No replay of those trials proposed.
limits: Host profile spans are instrumented and overlap; do not add upload and aggregate allocation envelopes.
Read duration includes Vec reserve/zero and read_exact_at, not pure SSD/NAND latency.
No enqueue instant/worker ID; queue tail cannot be causally isolated.
Page/no-copy alternative would touch alignment and current exactEXPERT_BYTES backing guard, so it is not the smallest variant.
No performance or correctness of proposed direct-backed read has been measured/verified.
executed: Read existing source/artifacts and aggregate existing JSON only; no prototype/build/test/proof/GPU/push.
